As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.About the roleIn this senior role you:- Provide corporate legal support and ensure corporate compliance for the global Nexperia group, including Nexperia Germany and the Hamburg site (which includes corporate housekeeping and ESG).- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.- Support the Deputy Chief Legal Officer ("DCLO") on specific matters in strategic corporate projects, such as in the field of Corporate/M&A, Finance, Tax and Treasury (which includes M&A, investments, strategic co-operations (incl R&D), intercompany agreements, treasury and insurance matters).- Deliver commercial legal support to certain key customers under the supervision of the DCLO.- Are managing disputes, litigation and claims (such as distributors, local suppliers etc).- Are managing outside legal counsel and legal spend.- Support the German Corporate Affairs department.The role is based at our office in Hamburg, and you will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer.What you will needThe ideal candidate has 6-10 years of relevant experience as a corporate lawyer or (in-house) legal counsel and is ready to further apply and deepen their expertise in an international environment.Furthermore, you have:- A completed university degree in law.- A truly international mindset and have excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).- Strong knowledge of and experience in corporate law and ESG in an international setting.- Relevant experience gained at a leading law firm and/or a multinational company (considered as an advantage).- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.- Litigation experience (considered an advantage).- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.

jobs.occupation: Dangerous Goods Expert (all genders) (full-time / part-time) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your role:In this pivotal role, you will shape the future of safe and compliant product transport across a broad global life science portfolio, driving regulatory excellence at scale. You will assess dangerous goods classifications, determine packaging requirements and transport restrictions, and develop compliant solutions in close collaboration with cross functional teams. Beyond day-to-day advisory work, you will lead the continuous improvement, streamlining, and automation of global dangerous goods processes, combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking mindset to increase both compliance and operational efficiency. Whether working within a team  or steering dedicated projects, you will act as a trusted expert and mentor, influencing technical direction and contributing to the strategic development of the function.This position is limited to 2 years.Who you are:- You hold a minimum master’s degree in chemistry or a related field.- You have a sound knowledge of dangerous goods transport and professional expertise in DG classification (DOT, RID/ADR, IATA, IMO, PK1 certification) as well as DG Safety Advisor training.- You have proven experience with SAP EHSM and common analytic tools.- You have proven experience in programming (e.g. Python, JAVA, KNIME).- You have strong project management and communication skills.- You have excellent German and English skills - C Level.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; prepare and execute functional testing and support integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness, deployment preparation, release notes, post-deployment validation, and hypercare; help prioritize incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancements.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; communicate effectively with business and technical audiences and facilitate decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Guide local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, end-user support, and complex or escalated topics.- Create or support process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Customer Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, interactions, accounts, contacts, knowledge, entitlements, and service history.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service performance, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement.- Analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify improvements; provide expert functional support for complex or escalated topics and coordinate with technical teams as needed.Your qualifications- Degree in business administration, economics, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.- At least 5 years in Business Analysis, CRM, Customer Service, commercial operations, or a related field—preferably Pharma/Life Sciences—including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud experience in a BA, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or similar role.- Expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshops, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, agile delivery, JIRA, and Confluence.- Hands-on Salesforce declarative and low-code configuration, including Flow; able to implement governed code-free changes and assess automation, errors, maintainability, and testing.- Strong Service Cloud knowledge: case management, routing/queues, channels, knowledge, entitlements, automation, security, data models, reporting, and integrations.- Experience in functional testing, UAT, defect triage, releases, and hypercare; knowledge of role-based access, profiles/permission sets, data protection, auditability, and controlled deployments.- Salesforce Business Analyst certification required or obtainable within an agreed period; Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certifications strongly preferred.- Strong analytical, conceptual, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills; able to balance value, user experience, standardization, risk, and maintainability.- Structured, independent, collaborative, results- and detail-oriented; accountable, interculturally competent, fluent in English, additional languages advantageous, and willing to travel internationally at least 30% as required.What we offerJoin #futurefresenius and drive the future of MedTech Quality with us. Make an impact in a strategic role that shapes organizational excellence in medical technology.ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application and join our team.
